name: The Collapsed Mine
description: A dungeon crawl through an abandoned mine with a dark secret beneath. Good for learning the basics.
openingNarration: The village of Thornhaven has a problem. Three days ago, a tremor shook the old silver mine on the hill above town. The entrance collapsed, trapping five miners inside. The village elder has offered a reward to anyone brave enough to find another way in and bring the miners home alive. You stand at the base of the hill, studying the overgrown paths that wind up through the forest. Somewhere up there, there's supposed to be a ventilation shaft — if it hasn't collapsed too.

npcs.name: Elder Maren
npcs.description: The village elder, a weathered woman in her sixties with kind eyes and a firm handshake.
npcs.motivation: Save the trapped miners at any cost — but she knows more about what's in the deep tunnels than she's saying

npcs.name: Tobias
npcs.description: A young miner who escaped the collapse. Shaken, with a bandaged arm.
npcs.motivation: Wants to help but is terrified of going back underground — he saw something in the dark before the tremor

npcs.name: Foreman Greaves
npcs.description: The mine foreman, found unconscious near the blocked entrance. Burns on his hands that don't match any mining accident.
npcs.motivation: Was conducting unauthorized excavation in the deep tunnels and triggered the collapse — he's hiding his guilt

npcs.name: The Pale Woman
npcs.description: A figure glimpsed in the deep tunnels, her skin luminous in the dark. Miners have whispered about her for decades.
npcs.motivation: Guardian of something beneath the mine — not hostile, but not safe either

locations.name: Thornhaven
locations.description: A small mining village at the base of a forested hill

locations.name: The Old Mine Entrance
locations.description: Blocked by rubble. Dust still drifts from the cracks.

locations.name: The Ventilation Shaft
locations.description: A narrow shaft hidden in the forest, partially overgrown, with rusted ladder rungs

locations.name: The Upper Tunnels
locations.description: Silver-veined corridors with abandoned cart tracks. Water drips from the ceiling.

locations.name: The Collapse Zone
locations.description: A wall of broken timber and rock where the main tunnel caved in. Voices can be heard faintly from the other side.

locations.name: The Deep Excavation
locations.description: A freshly dug tunnel below the mine proper, descending into older stone that predates the mine by centuries

locations.name: The Crystal Chamber
locations.description: A natural cavern filled with pale crystal formations that hum faintly. The source of the tremor.

plotHooks: The collapse wasn't natural — something in the deep tunnels caused it
One of the trapped miners found something before the collapse — a carved stone door
The forest path to the ventilation shaft is not as abandoned as it seems — fresh footprints lead away from it
Foreman Greaves was digging where he shouldn't have been, and Elder Maren knew about it
The crystals in the deep chamber react to sound — shouting near them triggered the original tremor

items.name: Miner's Lantern
items.description: Oil lamp with a cracked lens, still burns

items.name: Tobias's Map
items.description: Rough sketch of the mine tunnels, drawn from memory — shows a question mark where the deep excavation begins

items.name: Crystal Shard
items.description: A finger-length crystal fragment that vibrates when held near the cavern walls

items.name: Greaves's Journal
items.description: A small notebook with measurements and sketches of carved symbols found in the deep excavation
